verdict.rationale: The reviewer's concern is valid: first-party docs clearly show defining roles and permissions, assigning permissions to roles and roles to users (auth0-docs-7, auth0-docs-39, auth0-docs-45), plus defining access roles for apps and APIs (auth0-docs-56, auth0-docs-95). However, nothing in the pack explicitly says these roles or permissions are surfaced in issued tokens; the only token-adjacent evidence is a general claim about handling authorization with scopes and granular permissions (auth0-docs-81), so token surfacing is implied, not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that roles/permissions are emitted as claims in access/ID tokens, documentation of how permissions are enforced at the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
